# `scripts/fp/animals/`

[Index](index.md)

## `scripts/fp/animals/animals_feature.gd`

extends `FpFeature`

Dogs, pigeons and cats in the street (integration feature "animals"). Some people out on foot walk a dog on a lead: residents whose household lives with a dog (unless they are off to work) and a share of everyone else, fewer at night and in the rain. A dog household's dog keeps to the front yard of its house while nobody walks it, and a resident coming out takes it along. The dogs (dog_pack.gd) heel, stop to sniff, roam round an owner who stands still, come over to a crouching hero, bark at the hero and at people going by, flinch at blows and shouts, defend an owner the hero hits (biting: hero_hit "bite") and leap clear of cars. E pets a dog close by. The bodies are Shiba Inus and huskies (dog_bodies.gd) with leads from the owner's hand to the collar (dog_leads.gd). Flocks of pigeons (pigeons.gd) forage on the sidewalks in front of shops and civic buildings and in the parks by day, go up together at a fright and land again once it is calm; E throws them crumbs. Cats (cats.gd) keep to some front yards and shop doors, and by night strays to the works yards and the parks: they rest, stroll, greet a crouching hero, hiss at dogs, stalk the pigeons and run from frights; E pets one. Barks, growls, whines, coos, wingbeats, meows, purrs, hisses and chatter go out on the bus (animal_called) for the audio feature. Motion runs on delta * sim.speed, so pause freezes it.

## `scripts/fp/animals/cat_life.gd`

extends `RefCounted`

The cats' behaviour; cats.gd decides where cats keep and feeds in the world before every step(). A cat keeps to its spot (a house's front yard, the sidewalk by a shop's door, or by night a stray's patch of sidewalk by a works yard or a park): it sits, loafs, grooms and sleeps there, and now and then stretches and strolls to another place round it. A friendly cat comes over to a crouching hero with its tail up and meows, and purrs when petted; an aloof one walks off from the first pet and from the hero walking at it; a skittish one runs from the hero coming near. A sprint past, a blow or a shout makes a cat jump and run; a dog close by makes it arch its back and hiss, and one coming at it (or still there after the hiss) sends it running. A hunter chatters at the pigeons on the ground nearby, stalks them low and slow, crouches with its tail twitching and pounces (the flock goes up: pigeon_flock.gd's cats), then sits down to groom as if nothing happened. A car about to run a cat down sends it running. Each cat plays its gait at the rate its speed asks for, and its CatRig sways the tail, lowers it on a frightened or wary cat and turns the head to what it watches.

## `scripts/fp/animals/cats.gd`

## `scripts/fp/animals/dog_bodies.gd`

extends `RefCounted`

The dogs' bodies: Quaternius' Shiba Inu and Husky (AP.DOG_SHIBA, AP.DOG_HUSKY), each scene under a root scaled from model units to its breed's height at the shoulder, with the scene's own AnimationPlayer playing the clips in place (the dog pack moves the root) and a DogRig on the skeleton for the tail, the head and the barks. start() loads the scenes on background threads; make() returns null until a scene is in, unless `blocking` (tests, photo shots) makes it wait. Without a scene a dog is a brown box stand-in.

### Constants

- `WS = preload("res://scripts/fp/world_scale.gd")`
- `AP = preload("res://scripts/fp/asset_paths.gd")`
- `LOADS = preload("res://scripts/fp/scene_loads.gd")`
- `RIG = preload("res://scripts/fp/animals/dog_rig.gd")`
- `BREEDS = { "shiba": {"path": AP.DOG_SHIBA, "shoulder_m": 0.38}, "husky": {"path": AP.DOG_HUSKY, ...`: Each breed's scene and height at the shoulder (m). Both models share one skeleton, whose shoulder stands SHOULDER_UNITS model units high.
- `SHOULDER_UNITS = 2.35`
- `WALK_UNITS = 2.35`: Model units per second the planted paws cover at rate 1, walking and galloping.
- `GALLOP_UNITS = 7.0`
- `BLEND = 0.2`: Blend (s) from one clip into the next.
- `VIS = 3.0`: Draw distance (60 m).
- `STAND_IN_COLOR = Color(0.55, 0.36, 0.2)`

### Properties

- `breeds: Dictionary`: The kinds this loader makes (BREEDS for the dogs), the shoulder's height in model units and the name its bodies' nodes start with.

### Inner classes

- `Body`: One dog's body.

### Functions

- `func check() -> bool`: Checks the breeds' scenes exist. False (and why) when one is missing: make() then hands out stand-ins for it.
- `func start() -> void`: Starts loading every breed's scene on a background thread.
- `func finish_loads() -> void`: Waits for the loads still in flight (quitting with one running aborts it noisily).
- `func make(breed: String, size: float, parent: Node3D) -> Body`: A body of breed under parent, size times the breed's height, or null while its scene still loads. Reuses a released body of the same breed first.
- `func release(b: Body) -> void`: Takes b off the street for a later make() of the same breed.
- `func clear() -> void`: Frees the released bodies (teardown).
- `static func gait_speed(b: Body, gallop: bool) -> float`: Ground speed (u/s) b covers walking (or galloping) at clip rate 1.
- `static func play(b: Body, clip: StringName, rate: float, again: bool = false) -> void`: Plays clip on b at rate, blending from the clip before; again restarts a clip it already plays (a one-shot asked for once more).
- `static func bone_point(b: Body, k: int, fallback: Vector2) -> Vector3`: World position of bone k of b (the collar or the head), else a point up and ahead of the feet by the model's proportions (forward, up in model units).

## `scripts/fp/animals/dog_pack.gd`

extends `RefCounted`

The dogs' behaviour; the animals feature decides who has a dog and feeds in the world before every step(). A dog on its lead walks at its owner's left, stops now and then to sniff until the lead pulls it on, and is let off the lead to roam around an owner who stands still (in a park, say); a yard dog keeps to the front of its home and barks at people going by when it is the barking kind. Around the hero a friendly dog looks up and wags, trots over to a crouching hero and hops when petted; a barky one barks, a shy one backs off. Swings, blows and shouts close by make dogs flinch and bark; a dog whose owner the hero hits defends them, growling, barking and going for the hero's legs (on_bite). A car about to run a dog down makes it leap aside. Every dog plays Walk or Gallop at the rate its speed asks for, and its DogRig wags the tail, turns the head to what it watches and jerks it up with each bark.

### Constants

- `WS = preload("res://scripts/fp/world_scale.gd")`
- `BODIES = preload("res://scripts/fp/animals/dog_bodies.gd")`
- `HEEL_SIDE = 0.3 * WS.M`: Heel: beside the owner's left foot (HEEL_SIDE m out past the dog's own radius) and HEEL_BACK m back, closing the gap at HEEL_GAIN (1/s).
- `HEEL_BACK = 0.15 * WS.M`
- `HEEL_GAIN = 2.5`
- `LEAD = 1.8 * WS.M`: The lead (m): a dog on its lead further from its owner's feet is pulled along.
- `STILL = 0.15 * WS.M`: An owner slower than STILL (m/s) for UNCLIP_S lets the dog off the lead; it roams within ROAM (m) of them, a yard dog within YARD of its spot.
- `UNCLIP_S = 3.0`
- `ROAM = 6.0 * WS.M`
- `YARD = 2.4 * WS.M`
- `STROLL = 0.7 * WS.M`: Speeds (m/s), acceleration (m/s²) and turn rate (rad/s).
- `TROT = 2.0 * WS.M`
- `RUN = 4.5 * WS.M`
- `ACCEL = 6.0 * WS.M`
- `TURN = 7.0`
- `RADIUS_K = 0.42`: Collision radius and height as shares of the height at the shoulder.
- `HEIGHT_K = 1.3`
- `WALK_RATE = Vector2(0.45, 4.2)`: Clip rates: Walk from WALK_RATE.x to WALK_RATE.y times its own speed (a quick Walk stands in for the trot a small dog keeps up with its owner at), faster than that Gallop (back to Walk below WALK_BACK times the walk speed) at GALLOP_RATE.
- `WALK_BACK = 3.6`
- `GALLOP_RATE = Vector2(0.6, 2.4)`
- `NOTICE = 5.0 * WS.M`: The hero: noticed within NOTICE (m), barked at by a barky dog within BARK_AT, avoided by a shy one within SHY, kept GAP clear of; a crouching hero within GREET draws a friendly dog over.
- `BARK_AT = 3.0 * WS.M`
- `SHY = 1.4 * WS.M`
- `GAP = 0.25 * WS.M`
- `GREET = 4.0 * WS.M`
- `GREET_AT = 0.6 * WS.M`
- `BRUSH = 1.2 * WS.M`: Sprinting past closer than BRUSH (m) faster than BRUSH_MPS (m/s) startles a dog.
- `BRUSH_MPS = 3.0 * WS.M`
- `ANGRY_S = 12.0`: Defending its owner: angry for ANGRY_S (s), it goes for the hero within LUNGE (m), the jaws closing BITE_AT s into its Attack clip (played at LUNGE_RATE) on a hero within BITE_REACH (m of the head); at most BITES bites, LUNGE_COOL s apart.
- `LUNGE = 1.3 * WS.M`
- `LUNGE_RATE = 1.3`
- `BITE_AT = 0.4`
- `BITE_REACH = 0.8 * WS.M`
- `BITES = 2`
- `LUNGE_COOL = 2.0`
- `BARK_GAP = Vector2(0.32, 0.6)`: A volley's gap between barks (s) and the rest before a dog barks again on its own (s).
- `BARK_REST = Vector2(10.0, 20.0)`
- `DODGE_S = 1.2`: A car within its length plus DODGE_S seconds of travel ahead and DODGE_SIDE (m) beside its path makes a dog leap aside.
- `DODGE_SIDE = 0.6 * WS.M`
- `EYES = Vector2(1.55 * WS.M, 0.95 * WS.M)`: Where the hero's eyes are for a dog looking up at them (m), standing and crouched.
- `PERSON_R = 0.25 * WS.M`: People going by take this much room (m): a dog steps out of their way.
- `IDLES = [&"Idle", &"Idle_2", &"Idle_2_HeadLow"]`
- `ACT_CLIPS = {"hop": &"Jump_ToIdle", "lunge": &"Attack", "sniff": &"Eating"}`
- `NO_POINT = Vector3(NAN, NAN, NAN)`

### Properties

- `on_call: Callable`: Called with (dog, call) when a dog barks, growls or whines, and with (dog) when its lunge lands.
- `hero`: The world this step, set by the feature: the hero's feet and velocity, whether they are on foot (not driving, not in photo mode), open to a bite and crouched; moving cars as [pos, vel, half length, half width]; the feet of the people on foot around; the game's time scale.

### Inner classes

- `Dog`: One dog.

### Functions

- `func add(b: BODIES.Body, pos: Vector3, yaw: float) -> Dog`: A new dog with body b standing at pos facing yaw.
- `func remove(d: Dog) -> void`: Takes d off the street (the feature releases its body).
- `func to_owner(d: Dog, wid: int) -> void`: Puts d on the lead of person wid (traffic's walkers_near id); follow() tells it where they are.
- `func to_yard(d: Dog, lot: int, anchor: Vector3, box: Rect2) -> void`: Sends d to keep to the front of lot: it roams within YARD of anchor, inside box (xz).
- `func follow(d: Dog, e: Dictionary, dt: float) -> void`: The owner this frame (traffic's walkers_by_id entry: feet, facing, down, hand); dt game s since the last one gives their velocity.
- `func step(dt: float) -> void`: One step of dt game seconds for every dog.
- `func bark(d: Dog, n: int, force: bool) -> void`: Starts a volley of n barks, unless the dog is barking or barked lately (force: anyway).
- `func startle(d: Dog, src: Vector3) -> void`: Something went off at src close by (a blow, a swing, a sprint past): the dog flinches away and barks; a shy one whines instead.
- `func defend(d: Dog) -> void`: The hero hit the dog's owner: it growls and barks, and goes for the hero while they are close.
- `func pet(d: Dog) -> bool`: The hero pets the dog: it hops and wags, and a barky or shy dog warms to them. False, with a growl, while it is angry.
- `func head_of(d: Dog) -> Vector3`: The dog's head, and the ring on its collar the lead clips to (world points).
- `func collar_of(d: Dog) -> Vector3`
- `func shoulder_m(d: Dog) -> float`: Height at the shoulder (m).
- `func leads() -> Array`: [hand, collar, lead length, ground y] of every lead on, for DogLeads.
- `static func car_danger(p: Vector3, c: Array, side_m: float) -> Vector3`: The way to leap from car c ([pos, vel, half length, half width]) when it is about to run down an animal at p (within its length plus DODGE_S of travel ahead and side_m beside its path), else ZERO.

## `scripts/fp/animals/dog_rig.gd`

extends `SkeletonModifier3D`

A dog's life on top of its clip (DogBodies puts one on every dog skeleton): the tail wags (wag 0..1, faster as it grows), the head turns and tilts toward a world point (look) and jerks up with each bark (bark 1, easing back to 0 here). It turns bones about the model's own up and right axes, found once from the transforms between the skeleton and the scene root, so it does not depend on how the bones are rolled.

### Constants

- `TAIL = ["Tail1", "Tail2", "Tail3", "Tail4", "Tail5", "Tail6"]`
- `WAG_ANGLE = 0.4`: Swing of each tail bone at full wag (rad), the beat from a calm to a delighted wag (Hz) and the lag from one tail bone to the next (rad of the beat).
- `WAG_HZ = Vector2(1.5, 4.5)`
- `WAG_LAG = 0.7`
- `LOOK_YAW = 1.1`: How far the head turns and tilts toward look (rad, the neck takes NECK_SHARE of it) and how fast it follows (1/s); a point further behind than LOOK_GIVE_UP is not followed at all.
- `LOOK_UP = 0.7`
- `LOOK_DOWN = 0.3`
- `LOOK_RATE = 6.0`
- `LOOK_GIVE_UP = 1.9`
- `NECK_SHARE = 0.4`
- `HEAD_UNITS = 2.65`: The head's height in model units (the tilt toward look starts there).
- `BARK_LIFT = 0.3`: Head lift at a bark's peak (rad) and how fast a bark eases off (1/s).
- `BARK_FALL = 7.0`

### Properties

- `look`: World point to look at; NAN x for straight ahead.
- `pace: float`: Game seconds per real second (0 while the game is paused).

### Functions

- `func bind(skel: Skeleton3D, scene: Node3D, tail: Array[String] = TAIL, neck := "Neck1") ->`: Finds the bones (the tail's, root first, and the neck's) and the model's axes in skeleton space (the animal faces +Z in scene, its right is -X).
- `func calm() -> void`: Back to a still tail and a straight head (a body going back to the pool).

## `scripts/fp/animals/pigeon_flock.gd`

extends `RefCounted`

The pigeons' behaviour; the pigeons node (pigeons.gd) decides where flocks live and feeds in the world before every step(). A flock forages round its spot: each bird walks from place to place with the pigeon's head bob, pecks at the ground, stands about, and now and then a cock puffs up and turns round cooing. Birds walk out of the way of people and off from the hero walking at them; one too close, or about to be run over, flutters a few metres off. A sprint close by, a swing or a shout, a blow, a dog near or running, or a crowd of birds in a car's way sends the flock up together (scatter()): they burst off with a clatter of wings, climb away from the fright, wheel round over the street or the park and glide back down to land once it is calm. Crumbs (feed()) bring the flock in close, round the hero's feet, until they are eaten.

### Constants

- `WS = preload("res://scripts/fp/world_scale.gd")`
- `WALK = 0.32 * WS.M`: Walking (m/s) foraging and hurrying (off, or to crumbs); a step's length (m), which sets the head's bob and the stride; turning on the ground (rad/s); the room each bird keeps (m).
- `HURRY = 0.85 * WS.M`
- `STEP_M = 0.075`
- `TURN = 7.0`
- `SPACE = 0.13 * WS.M`
- `PECK_S = 0.34`: A peck lasts PECK_S (s); a bout is PECKS of them.
- `PECKS = Vector2i(2, 5)`
- `WARY = 2.6 * WS.M`: The hero on foot walking at a bird within WARY (m) faster than WARY_MPS sends it off on foot; within SHY it flutters off; a sprint (SPRINT_MPS) within FRIGHT of the flock sends it up. Crumbs on the ground cut WARY and SHY to FED_K of themselves.
- `WARY_MPS = 0.3 * WS.M`
- `SHY = 1.0 * WS.M`
- `SPRINT_MPS = 2.8 * WS.M`
- `FRIGHT = 6.0 * WS.M`
- `FED_K = 0.3`
- `MAKE_WAY = 1.3 * WS.M`: People going by: within MAKE_WAY (m) a bird walks out of their way, within TRAMPLE it flutters.
- `TRAMPLE = 0.45 * WS.M`
- `DOG_NEAR = 3.0 * WS.M`: A dog within DOG_NEAR (m) of a bird, or running (DOG_RUN_MPS, faster than a walk at heel) within DOG_FAR, sends the flock up; a cat only within CAT_NEAR (one stalking low and slow gets that close) or running (a pounce). The flock lands again once they are twice their near off.
- `DOG_FAR = 6.0 * WS.M`
- `DOG_RUN_MPS = 2.5 * WS.M`
- `CAT_NEAR = 0.8 * WS.M`
- `DODGE_S = 1.0`: A car within DODGE_S seconds of travel and DODGE_SIDE (m) of its path makes a bird flutter off; CROWD birds in its way at once send the flock up.
- `DODGE_SIDE = 1.0 * WS.M`
- `CROWD = 3`
- `HOP_M = Vector2(1.5, 3.0)`: A flutter: HOP_M (m) away over HOP_S (s), HOP_UP (m) high at the top.
- `HOP_S = 0.75`
- `HOP_UP = 0.5`
- `LIFT = 3.2 * WS.M`: Taking off: up (m/s) and away from the fright for UP_S (s), the nearest birds DELAY_S (s) ahead of the far ones; flying (m/s) and its acceleration (m/s²).
- `AWAY = 2.4 * WS.M`
- `UP_S = Vector2(0.9, 1.3)`
- `DELAY_S = 0.25`
- `CRUISE = 8.5 * WS.M`
- `AIR_ACCEL = 9.0 * WS.M`
- `ALARM_S = Vector2(6.0, 9.0)`: A fright keeps the flock up ALARM_S (s). It wheels at least WHEEL_S, then lands once nothing is within CALM (m) of its spot, and after WHEEL_MAX anyway (as far from the trouble as it can).
- `WHEEL_S = 6.0`
- `WHEEL_MAX = 25.0`
- `CALM = 3.5 * WS.M`
- `GLIDE = 0.55`: Gliding in: height lost per metre, speed (m/s) and where the flare starts (m from the spot).
- `LAND_MPS = Vector2(1.2, 6.0)`
- `FLARE = 0.9 * WS.M`
- `BEAT_HZ = Vector3(9.5, 6.5, 8.0)`: Wingbeats (Hz) taking off, cruising and flaring; the wing's angle (rad) at the bottom and top of a beat and held in a glide.
- `BEAT = Vector2(-0.75, 1.2)`
- `GLIDE_WING = 0.42`
- `STREET_WHEELS = [Vector3(16.0, 5.0, 7.0), Vector3(16.0, 5.0, 12.0), Vector3(10.0, 4.0, 9.0)]`: The wheels tried, first that fits between the buildings: (along, across, up) m, along the street (centred over the road) for a sidewalk flock, round the spot for a park's; LAST_WHEEL above the roofs when none fits.
- `PARK_WHEELS = [Vector3(12.0, 12.0, 8.0), Vector3(12.0, 12.0, 14.0)]`
- `LAST_WHEEL = Vector3(14.0, 14.0, 24.0)`
- `WHEEL_POINTS = 12`
- `CRUMBS = 24`: Crumbs: CRUMBS scattered within CRUMB_R (m); a peck within EAT (m) of one eats it at EAT_CHANCE.
- `CRUMB_R = 0.45 * WS.M`
- `EAT = 0.1 * WS.M`
- `EAT_CHANCE = 0.35`
- `COO_AT = 15.0 * WS.M`: A calm flock within COO_AT (m) of the hero coos every COO_S (s); a cock's display turns him round over DISPLAY_S.
- `COO_S = Vector2(5.0, 12.0)`
- `DISPLAY_S = 2.6`
- `MORPHS = [ [Color(1.0, 1.0, 1.0), 0.42], [Color(0.62, 0.62, 0.66), 0.25], [Color(0.25, 0.25, 0.2...`: Morphs (linear tints of the blue bar) and their shares: blue bar, checker, dark, red, pale.
- `NO_POINT = Vector3(NAN, NAN, NAN)`

### Properties

- `on_call: Callable`: Called with (at, call) for a "coo", a lone bird's "flap" and a flock's "takeoff".
- `hero`: The world this step, set by the pigeons node: the hero's feet and velocity and whether they are on foot; dogs as [feet, velocity] (and cats as [feet, velocity, CAT_NEAR]); the feet of the people on foot around; moving cars as [pos, vel, half length, half width].

### Inner classes

- `Bird`: One bird.
- `Flock`: One flock and the spot it keeps to.

### Functions

- `func add(key: String, home: Vector3, radius: float, run: Vector3, across: Vector3, n: int) -> Flock`: A flock of n foraging round home (on the ground) within radius (u): along run and across it (unit vectors, across toward the lot) on a sidewalk, round home in a park (run ZERO).
- `func remove(f: Flock) -> void`
- `func step(dt: float) -> void`: One step of dt game seconds for every flock.
- `func scatter(f: Flock, src: Vector3) -> void`: A fright at src sends the whole flock up, the birds nearest it first, with one clatter of wings (a lone bird's flap); birds coming down climb again.
- `func startle(src: Vector3, r: float) -> int`: A fright at src (a blow, a shout, a bark) sends up every flock with a bird on the ground within r (u) of it. Returns how many flocks went.
- `func feed(f: Flock, at: Vector3) -> void`: Crumbs scattered at at (on the ground): the flock comes for them, walking or flying in, and pecks round them until they are eaten.
- `static func pose(b: Bird) -> Color`: The pose the shader takes from INSTANCE_CUSTOM.
- `static func xform(b: Bird) -> Transform3D`: The bird's transform, scale the units per metre of its mesh times its size.

## `scripts/fp/animals/pigeons.gd`

extends `Node3D`

The pigeons (part of the animals feature): where flocks keep (the sidewalk in front of some shops and of the civic buildings people gather at, and the parks), coming out by day near the player and going beyond FAR; the world fed to their behaviour (pigeon_flock.gd) before every step; one MultiMesh of pigeon_body.gd's bird per flock, and the crumbs the hero throws them (E on a flock close by). Their coos and wingbeats go out on the bus (animal_called).

- `STREET_TRIES = [0.0, 0.12, -0.12, 0.24, -0.24]`: Homes tried along the street from the middle of the lot's front (u), and round a park's middle; a home needs HOME_ROOM (m) clear of props.
- `PARK_TRIES = [ Vector2.ZERO, Vector2(0.15, 0.0), Vector2(-0.15, 0.0), Vector2(0.0, 0.15), Vector2(0....`
- `HOME_ROOM = 0.6`
- `STARTLE = { "jab": 3.0, "cross": 3.0, "hook": 3.0, "kick": 3.5, "swing": 3.5, "shove": 3.0, "wave...`: The hero's swings, shove, wave, dance, shout and parkour moves send up the flocks within these (m); someone hit in the street those within SEEN_HIT, a dog's bark those within BARK_M, a crash those within CRASH_M and a prop knocked over those within KNOCK_M.
- `SEEN_HIT = 8.0`
- `BARK_M = 6.0`
- `CRASH_M = 25.0`
- `KNOCK_M = 8.0`
- `FEED_REACH = 4.5`: E feeds a flock with a bird on the ground within FEED_NEAR (m) of where the view meets the ground, FEED_REACH (m) or less from the hero's feet; the crumbs land FEED_TOSS (m) in front of them, toward it.
- `FEED_NEAR = 1.5`
- `FEED_TOSS = 1.2`
- `SIZE_M = 0.13`: A pigeon's height at the shoulder (m): animal_called's size.
- `CRUMB = Vector3(0.016, 0.007, 0.012)`: A crumb's size (m) and colour.
- `CRUMB_COL = Color(0.86, 0.74, 0.52)`
- `CAR = Vector2(2.3, 1.0)`: The player's car while they drive, half length and half width (m), for the birds' dodge.
- `PHOTO_KEY = "photo:pigeons"`: The photo shot stands STAND_M (m) from the flock's crumbs, looking PHOTO_PITCH (degrees) down.
- `STAND_M = 2.6`
- `PHOTO_PITCH = -28.0`
- `NO_POINT = Vector3(NAN, NAN, NAN)`

### Properties

- `calls: Dictionary`: Calls made so far by kind ("coo", "flap", "takeoff") and the times the hero fed a flock.

### Functions

- `func setup(p_ctx: FpContext) -> void`
- `func rebuilt() -> void`: Boot, load or New City: no flocks until the next scan.
- `func tile_built(_i: int) -> void`
- `func clear() -> void`
- `func scan(me: Vector3, by_day: bool) -> void`: Every scan: the flocks too far off go; by day (and with the flag on) the spots near me get theirs, the nearest first.
- `func world(pack: PACK, driving: bool, delta: float) -> void`: The world for this step from the dogs' pack: the hero on foot, the traffic's cars (and the player's while they drive) and the people on foot around, and the dogs. delta is real seconds.
- `func step(dt: float) -> void`: dt game seconds of the flocks (in MAX_STEP steps), then their draw. The flag off takes them away.
- `func startle(at: Vector3, r_m: float) -> void`: A fright at at (a blow, a shout, a bark, a crash) sends up the flocks with a bird on the ground within r_m metres of it.
- `func on_crash(at: Vector3, _speed: float, _what: String) -> void`
- `func on_knock(at: Vector3, _kind: String, _speed: float) -> void`
- `func pick(origin: Vector3, dir: Vector3, max_dist: float) -> Dictionary`: The flock the hero can feed: the view meets the ground FEED_REACH or less from their feet and within FEED_NEAR of one of its birds there. {"kind": "pigeons", "id" (its key), "tile", "pos" (that point), "dist", "label", "data": {"birds"}}, or {}.
- `func feed(t: Dictionary) -> bool`: E on a flock (pick's target t): the hero throws crumbs FEED_TOSS in front of them toward it and the birds come for them. False when the flock is gone.
- `func detail() -> String`: "12 pigeons in 2 flocks".
- `func photo_shot(me: Vector3) -> Dictionary`: The photo shot ("pigeons"): the flock spot nearest me with room to stand STAND_M from it, seen from there; photo_prepare() brings its birds in to feed on crumbs. {} without one (or with the flag off).
- `func photo_prepare() -> void`: The photo's flock (pinned, so the scan keeps it while the camera moves there) feeding round crumbs at its home, the birds already about them.
- `func photo_restore() -> void`
